convention.recession_months: Inclusive interval [peak + 1 month, trough]. A month equal to peak is NOT counted as recession; a month equal to trough IS counted as recession.

notes: NBER dates are the universally cited US business-cycle reference and are revised only retrospectively.
The committee publishes monthly (and, since 2020, also quarterly) peak/trough dates. Only the monthly dates are stored here.
These dates are 'final' as of retrieval date; if NBER ever revises a date the file should be updated.
